record.field: Parallel multi-department employee exit clearance with rework and post-approval automations.

Exit Clearance Demo

This demo flow covers:

  • Request owner submit and rework
  • HOD decision and final review
  • 8 department approvals in parallel
  • Payroll + HR final steps
  • Notification and server-action automation tasks
Initial enterprise exit clearance scenario with parallel departments and automation tasks.
